description: Schema for a single entry in a Claude Code session JSONL export. Each line of the export is one JSON object matching this schema. The runner filters for entries where hook_event_name == 'PostToolUseFailure'.

hook_event_name.description: Event type emitted by the Claude Code hook system.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that failed (for PostToolUseFailure entries).

tool_input.description: Input arguments passed to the tool.

tool_response.description: Error text from the failed tool call. Alias: 'error'.

error.description: Alias for tool_response used in some export formats.

session_id.description: UUID of the Claude Code session that produced this event.

tool_use_id.description: Unique ID for the individual tool invocation.

cwd.description: Working directory at the time of the hook event.

duration_ms.description: Time taken by the tool call in milliseconds.

is_interrupt.description: True if the tool call was interrupted before completing.

notes: Lines that are not valid JSON are counted as parse_errors and skipped.
Entries without hook_event_name are counted in entries_seen but not as failures.
The runner does not enforce strict type checking on individual fields; it relies on the adapter to handle missing/malformed values gracefully.
